criteria.evidence: SCHEMA HALF CONFIRMED BY ME against scratch_head_1010 (685/685 journalled migrations applied = backend main e1fd1d475's journal head; 944 public tables). (1) 36 payroll/payslip/salary/employee_salary tables; `select ... from pg_attribute where atttypid in ('float4','float8')` over all 36 -> ZERO rows, so 0 float money columns. Integer paise end to end: backend/src/modules/payroll/runs/lib/money.ts:6 toPaise/fromPaise, and journal.service.ts:73,110 now sum `round(amount*100)::text` inside Postgres. (2) pg_trigger: EXACTLY 8 BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE guards -- trg_guard_released_payroll_bank_batch_item, trg_guard_released_payroll_bank_batch, trg_guard_submitted_payroll_filing, trg_guard_posted_payroll_journal_batch_line, trg_guard_posted_payroll_journal_batch, trg_guard_locked_payroll_line_item, trg_guard_locked_payroll_run_employee, trg_guard_paid_payroll_tds_ytd_row. Migrations 0445_payroll_locked_run_immutability, 1001_s08_payroll_financial_immutability, 1030_t24_payroll_tds_ytd_immutability are all in migrations/meta/_journal.json. (3) RLS: 35 of 36 tables have relrowsecurity=t with exactly 1 policy; only payroll_scheduler_state is exempt (global job lease, no org_id) -- correct in substance, though the criterion's written count '30/31' is stale. (4) Natural keys present in pg_indexes: uniq_payroll_bank_batch_items_batch_subject (org_id,batch_id,run_employee_id), uniq_payroll_bank_batch_items_live_subject (org_id,run_employee_id) WHERE status <> 'FAILED', uniq_payroll_tds_ytd_user_period (org_id,user_id,fiscal_year,period_key,run_id) WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL and its worker twin -- migrations 1049/1050 both journalled. THE 'BITE-PROVED' CLAUSE IS UNTRUE. CLAIMED: 'Two missing natural keys fixed by migrations 1049 and 1050, both verified in pg_catalog and bite-proved' and '3 P0 financial-integrity defects fixed and bite-proved (double-payment path, TDS year-to-date under-report...)'. FOUND: `grep -rn 'uniq_payroll_bank_batch_items_live_subject|uniq_payroll_bank_batch_items_batch_subject|uniq_payroll_tds_ytd_user_period' --include=*.ts .` returns ZERO spec files -- only src/db/schema/payroll/payout.ts, src/db/schema/payroll/entities-periods.ts and src/modules/payroll/payout/batch-creator.service.ts:31-32. No spec anywhere in src/ or test/ constructs BatchCreatorService: the only two references are e2e-specs (payroll-db-integration.e2e-spec.ts:412 and payroll-payout.controller.e2e-spec.ts:75, which mocks it away), and *e2e-spec files run only under `pnpm test:e2e`, which was not run. The single spec that names the defect, src/modules/payroll/__tests__/payroll-invariants.spec.ts:196, says so itself: 'Inline simulation of the BatchCreatorService double-pay guards'. Its imports (lines 8-11) are calculation-engine and payroll.types only -- nothing from payout/ -- and its filterEligibleEmployees() at :214 is a locally re-declared function that models a DIFFERENT predicate (an `alreadyPaidIds` set, no bank-account check) than the shipped one (batch-creator.service.ts:99-119 excludes every non-FAILED live instruction and requires bank.accountNumber). Reverting batch-creator.service.ts leaves that suite green. For 1050, locking-tds-ledger-bulk.spec.ts:141-163 asserts only the targetWhere predicate strings ('user_id', 'is not null'); `grep -n run_id` over that spec finds no assertion, so deleting payrollTdsYtdLedger.runId from the ON CONFLICT target at locking.service.ts:290/310 fails no test. I also measured that all three payroll .db.spec.ts files are describe.skip'd in a default run: `jest --testPathPattern='payout-run-completion.db|journal-completeness.db|journal-reversal.db'` -> 'Test Suites: 3 skipped, 0 of 3 total; Tests: 8 skipped'. Only with PAYROLL_DB_TESTS=1 DATABASE_URL=...scratch_head_1010 did payout-run-completion.db.spec.ts run and pass (2/2, 13.5s).
criteria.blocker: No regression test exists for either natural key. The double-payment guard has zero automated coverage in any suite that runs (its only 'test' is a self-contained simulation that imports nothing from payout/); the TDS run_id arbiter has no assertion naming run_id. `check:declaration-constraint-drift` -- the gate that would catch a dropped constraint against the live catalog -- is exit 2 (INCONCLUSIVE) in GATE-STATUS.tsv, so nothing covers this from the schema side either.

criteria.evidence: Three of five clauses hold. Bounded reads / projections / N+1: check:unbounded-reads, check:query-projections and check:n1-growing-loops are all exit 0 in GATE-STATUS.tsv (2026-09-04, backend main). Async exports: payroll-export.service.ts is org- and requester-scoped, keyset-paginated and idempotent. The two silent-truncation P0s the 08 audit found are FIXED at main and I read the fixes: journal.service.ts:66-107 now GROUPs in SQL, orders deterministically and ends `.limit(PAYROLL_READ_CAP + 1)` behind requirePayrollReadWithinCap at :120; run-data-loader.service.ts:122 wraps loadEligibleProfiles in requirePayrollReadWithinCap. INVALIDATION AFTER LOCK FAILS. Backend has no server cache to invalidate (`grep -rn 'CacheService|cachedVersioned|invalidateNamespace' src/modules/payroll/` -> 0 non-spec hits), so the clause resolves entirely to the Query cache, and there it is incomplete: frontend/hooks/api/payroll/approvals.ts:80-92 useInvalidateRunWorkspace() -- the sole onSuccess for useLockRun, useReopenRun and useCloseRun -- invalidates run, [...all,'runs'], runInputsAll, runExceptionsAll, runEmployeesAll, runVariance and commandCenterAll, but NOT queryKeys.payroll.bankBatches(runId) and NOT queryKeys.payroll.bankValidation(runId). So after a lock the bank pre-flight validation panel keeps rendering blockers the lock resolved. Publish is fine by contrast (publications.ts:30-35 sweeps five surfaces including essPayslips and commandCenterAll). Separately, hooks/api/payroll/payout-batches.ts:130-140 useMarkBatchPaid -- the mutation that flips the run to PAID server-side -- invalidates bankBatch(batchId), bankBatches(runId) and run(runId) but never [...all,'runs'], and run(runId)=[...,'payroll','runs',1] does not prefix-match runs(params)=[...,'payroll','runs',{...}], so the runs list keeps showing LOCKED for its 60s staleTime. Residual unguarded truncation: 38 hard-coded `.limit(N>1)` reads remain in src/modules/payroll/** against 16 requirePayrollReadWithinCap call sites (191 .limit() calls total) -- e.g. runs/lib/checklist.ts:158,166,181,204 and payroll-run-variance.service.ts:104,113 at .limit(1000).
criteria.blocker: The 'correct invalidation after lock/publish/reversal' clause. The lock/reopen/close path (frontend/hooks/api/payroll/approvals.ts:80-92) never invalidates bankBatches or bankValidation. The ticket's own text does not meet this clause either -- it deflects it to ticket 19 rather than closing it.
criteria.clauses_failing: correct invalidation after lock/publish/reversal (lock and reversal halves; publish holds)

criteria.evidence: Two clauses hold, three do not. HOLDS -- permission gates: 112 useAuthorizedMutation call sites in frontend/hooks/api/payroll/ and 0 raw useMutation( (measured by grep). HOLDS -- partial failure: the 08 audit's F6 is fixed; features/payroll/reports/report-summary.tsx:27-37 now branches on isError to <ErrorState> before the 'No payroll run for this period' empty state. FAILS -- conflict/retry: features/payroll/shared/run-conflict.ts's useRunConflictHandler has 6 call sites, all run-lifecycle (run-actions-slot.tsx:36, exceptions-tab.tsx:89, publish-payslips-action.tsx:30, lock-actions.tsx:34,83,148). The batch mutations do not use it: features/payroll/payout/bank-transfers/generate-payout-dialog.tsx:83 is `onError: (err) => toast.error(getErrorMessage(err))`, so the 409 that migration 1049 now raises ('A payout instruction already exists for one of these payees on this run', batch-creator.service.ts:287) surfaces as an anonymous toast with no refetch of the stale list that caused it. FAILS -- secure downloads: features/payroll/payout/bank-transfers/batches-table.tsx:84 `onSuccess: ({ url }) => window.open(url, '_blank', ...)` opens a 3600s presigned URL (payout-batches.service.ts:178 getFileUrl(orgId, key, 3600)) to a CSV that carries the UNMASKED account number (batch-creator.service.ts:201 writes bank.accountNumber into the row while :207 stores only 'XXXX'+last4 in the DB) -- browser history for an hour, while every other payroll download uses apiClient.download. FAILS -- E2E: not run, as the ticket admits. Six payroll *e2e-spec.ts files exist (payroll-db-integration, journal-outbox.controller, payroll-insights.controller, payroll-payout.controller, payroll-runs.controller, payroll-setup.controller); jest.testPathIgnorePatterns includes 'e2e-spec', so they run only under `pnpm test:e2e` / `test:e2e:seeded`, and no evidence artifact for such a run exists. I also measured that the cited '124 payroll suites / 967 tests exit 0' does not cover the calculation/locking/reconciliation DB proofs: `jest --testPathPattern='payout-run-completion.db|journal-completeness.db|journal-reversal.db'` reports 'Test Suites: 3 skipped, 0 of 3 total; Tests: 8 skipped, 8 total' because each is describe.skip without PAYROLL_DB_TESTS=1. With the flag set against scratch_head_1010, payout-run-completion.db.spec.ts passes 2/2 -- so the proofs are real but are not in the run the ticket counted. check:test-suppressions is exit 1 in GATE-STATUS.tsv ('FAIL -- 66 runtime-selected suppressions, above the ratchet of 29'), which is this same class.
criteria.blocker: The seeded E2E half was never run (no `pnpm test:e2e` evidence anywhere), and the three DB proofs that would stand in for part of it are env-gated out of the default suite. Plus two live frontend defects on named clauses: batch-mutation 409s bypass the conflict handler, and the bank file is handed to window.open as a 1-hour presigned URL containing unmasked account numbers.
criteria.clauses_failing: calculation/locking/reconciliation E2E (never run); conflict/retry (batch mutations); secure downloads (window.open of a 3600s presigned URL to unmasked bank data)
